Verified 2026-09-24: creator explicitly permits commercial/non-commercial use and editing, and marks PIXWEP CC0. Official free PIXWEP.zip downloaded, upload 1812689.
Gauss, laser, flame and lightning icons assemble the pack's original PNG body/barrel/stock/scope modules in SVG wrappers. No purchase-only pack used.

Mine, missile and drone reuse Kenney CC0 artwork already included in the game.
See LICENSE-combat.txt and LICENSE-drone.txt for sources.
Nova and small identifying accents use original SVG geometry.
SVG wrappers embed the selected PNG modules; no external runtime image requests.
